question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH last_races AS (
  SELECT year, race_id FROM races WHERE (year, round) IN (SELECT year, MAX(round) FROM races GROUP BY year)
),
driver_leaders AS (
  SELECT lr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points
  FROM last_races lr
  JOIN driver_standings ds ON lr.race_id = ds.race_id
  WHERE ds.position = 1
),
constructor_leaders AS (
  SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points
  FROM last_races lr
  JOIN constructor_standings cs ON lr.race_id = cs.race_id
  WHERE cs.position = 1
)
SELECT dl.year,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
       dl.points AS driver_points,
       c.name AS constructor_name,
       cl.points AS constructor_points
FROM driver_leaders dl
JOIN drivers d ON dl.driver_id = d.driver_id
LEFT JOIN constructor_leaders cl ON dl.year = cl.year
LEFT JOIN constructors c ON cl.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY dl.year
